name: Voluntary Provident Fund (VPF)

conventions.compounding: Identical to EPF -- same annual rate, same crediting method
conventions.structure: VPF is a voluntary top-up contribution (beyond the statutory 12%) to a member's own EPF account, permitted up to 100% of basic pay + DA; it is NOT a separate account or separate interest rate

periods.note: VPF is not a distinct interest-bearing instrument: voluntary contributions are simply added to the member's EPF account and earn exactly the EPF rate declared for each financial year. See epf.json for the full dated rate history; do not duplicate -- read from epf.json programmatically.

gaps: By design, no separate rate history exists or is needed; consumers of this dataset should join VPF balances to epf.json's periods rather than expect a distinct table here.
notes: Deliberately a thin pointer file. All dated rates live in epf.json.
